patterns: What kind of platform is this?
responses: Mallify is a virtual mall where anyone can access and open a shop to sell products. We provide a platform for both shoppers to find various products and vendors to set up their online shops easily.

patterns: How do I create a shop?
I want to sell on Mallify
responses: To create a shop on Mallify, go to the 'Become a Seller' section and fill out the registration form. You'll need to provide your shop details, contact information, and upload some product images. Our team will review your application and approve it shortly.

You can manage your shop through the Seller Dashboard. Log in to your account, go to 'My Shop', and you'll find options to add/edit products, update shop information, view orders, and track your performance.

Shopping on Mallify is easy! Browse products, add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, fill in your delivery details, and choose payment on delivery. You'll receive confirmation and can track your order status from your account.

At Mallify, we currently offer payment on delivery to ensure a safer shopping experience. When your order arrives, you can pay in cash directly to the delivery person. We're working on adding more payment options in the future.

patterns: When will I receive my order?
responses: Delivery times depend on your location and the seller. Typically, orders are delivered within 2-5 business days. You can track your order status from your account dashboard under 'My Orders'.

If you're not satisfied with your purchase, you can initiate a return within 7 days of delivery. Contact the seller directly through the platform, explain the issue, and follow the return instructions. Refunds are processed once the returned item is received.

For account issues, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset your password. To update account information, log in and go to 'My Account' settings. If you're still having trouble, contact our support team for assistance.
You can find products by using the search bar at the top of the page, browsing categories, or using filters for price, brand, etc. You can also explore featured shops and products on our homepage.

I'm sorry you're experiencing technical issues. Try refreshing the page or clearing your browser cache. If the problem persists, please contact our technical support at support@mallify.com with details about the issue.

You can contact our support team through the 'Contact Us' page, by email at support@mallify.com, or use the live chat feature at the bottom right of the screen during business hours (9 AM - 6 PM, Monday to Friday).

We're excited to announce that a Mallify mobile app is coming soon! We're currently developing applications for both iOS and Android to make your shopping experience even more convenient. Stay tuned for the launch announcement.

patterns: How much does it cost to sell?
responses: Mallify charges a competitive commission of 5% on each sale. There are no monthly fees or listing charges - you only pay when you make a sale. This includes access to all seller tools and features on our platform.

Mallify supports a wide range of categories including fashion, electronics, home & garden, beauty, sports, toys, and more. Prohibited items include illegal goods, weapons, adult content, and counterfeit products. Check our seller guidelines for a complete list.

To create an account, click the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner of the page. Fill in your details (name, email, password), agree to the terms, and click 'Create Account'. You'll receive a confirmation email to verify your account.
Mallify supports multiple languages including English, Arabic, French, and German. You can change your preferred language from the dropdown menu in the top navigation bar.

patterns: How to save products for later
responses: You can save products to your wishlist by clicking the heart icon on any product. To view your saved items, log in to your account and go to 'My Wishlist'. From there, you can move items to your cart or remove them from your wishlist.

You can track your order by logging into your account and going to 'My Orders'. Click on the specific order to see its current status and tracking information. If the seller has provided a tracking number, you'll be able to click on it to see detailed delivery updates.

At Mallify, we take your security and privacy seriously. We use industry-standard encryption for all transactions, never store complete credit card information, and have strict data protection policies in place. You can review our detailed Privacy Policy in the footer of our website.

You can see shop ratings on each seller's profile page. After completing a purchase, you'll receive an invitation to rate and review the seller. These ratings help other shoppers make informed decisions and help us maintain quality standards across Mallify.

After receiving your order, you can write a product review by going to 'My Orders', finding the item, and clicking 'Write a Review'. Your honest feedback helps other customers and also helps sellers improve their products and services.

Many sellers on Mallify offer gift options! During checkout, look for the 'Send as Gift' option. Depending on the seller, you may be able to add gift wrapping, a personalized message, or a gift receipt. The available gift options will be displayed on the product page or during checkout.

International shipping availability depends on the individual sellers on Mallify. When browsing products, you can filter for items that ship to your country. During checkout, you'll see shipping options and costs for international delivery if the seller offers it.

Yes, Mallify is active on social media! You can follow us on Instagram (@mallify_official), Facebook (Mallify Marketplace), Twitter (@mallify), and LinkedIn. We regularly post about new shops, product highlights, and special promotions.
